examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 現在十二點半。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn bàn.
examples.english: It is half past twelve.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
examples.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 十點了，飛機快(要)起飛了。
examples.pinyin: Shí diǎn le, fēijī kuài (yào) qǐfēi le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock; the plane is about to take off.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese:
新學期快要開始了。
我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
examples.pinyin:
Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le.
Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.english:
The new semester is about to start.
We start class at 8:40 every day.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese:
我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。
他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò.
Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english:
My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job.
He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: 我們八點半開始上班，我每天都準時到公司。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ shàngbān, wǒ měi tiān dōu zhǔnshí dào gōngsī.
examples.english: We start work at 8:30; I arrive at the company on time every day.

examples.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
examples.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: B:好，沒問題？ A:我們明天晚上八點見。
examples.pinyin: B: Hǎo, méi wèntí? A: Wǒmen míngtiān wǎnshang bā diǎn jiàn.
examples.english: B: Okay, no problem? A: Let's see each other at eight tomorrow evening.

examples.chinese: 現在十點了，不早了，我想回家了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí diǎn le, bù zǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock now; it's not early anymore, I want to go home.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese:
小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。
老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi.
Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english:
Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee.
The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

examples.chinese:
這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。
老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān.
Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english:
This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting.
The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese:
秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。
這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin:
Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào.
Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english:
Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out.
This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese:
這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。
老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù.
Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english:
In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds.
The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese:
大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。
淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin:
Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì.
Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english:
Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day.
The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 我們班有十個學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu shí ge xuésheng.
examples.english: Our class has ten students.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 我們八點半開始上班，我每天都準時到公司。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ shàngbān, wǒ měi tiān dōu zhǔnshí dào gōngsī.
examples.english: We start work at 8:30; I arrive at the company on time every day.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
examples.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

examples.chinese:
大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。
雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin:
Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo.
Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english:
In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better.
Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese:
張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。
我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē.
Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english:
Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate.
My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese:
我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english:
My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding.
A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese:
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。
總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin:
Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá.
Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english:
That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather.
Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.
examples.english: The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people.

examples.chinese:
我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。
A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le.
A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english:
I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese:
站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。
「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin:
Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le.
Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english:
The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow.
Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

items.wordHook: a 王(jade) token stamps every seat in the row → one 班(class).

examples.chinese: 這種點心的做法很簡單，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diǎnxin de zuòfǎ hěn jiǎndān, jiàqián yě bú guì.
examples.english: The method for making this kind of snack is very simple, and the price is not expensive either.

examples.chinese: 我花了大約兩萬塊錢學做法國菜，希望能夠快點兒學會。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le dàyuē liǎngwàn kuài qián xué zuò Fǎguó cài, xīwàng nénggòu kuài diǎnr xuéhuì.
examples.english: I spent about 20,000 dollars learning to cook French cuisine, hoping to be able to learn it quickly.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
examples.pinyin: Māma cháng yībiān kàn zuòcài jiémù, yībiān bǎ zuòfǎ chāo xiàlái.
examples.english: Mom often watches cooking shows while copying down the recipes.

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 你說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ zuótiān chīle wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
examples.english: You say you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday—that's too exaggerated!

examples.chinese:
臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。
A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin:
Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì.
A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english:
Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied.
A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 你只買了一份雞排，吃得飽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ mǎi le yí fèn jīpái, chī de bǎo ma?
examples.english: You only bought one chicken cutlet; are you full from eating it?

examples.chinese: 大家都出去了，還好我帶了鑰匙。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu chūqù le, hái hǎo wǒ dài le yàoshi.
examples.english: Everyone has gone out; luckily I brought my keys.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě jīntiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāngtóng páizi de yángzhuāng, hái hǎo yánsè bùtóng.
examples.english: Miss Chen wore a dress of the same brand as mine today; fortunately, the color is different.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 還好你告訴我今天黃教授的課停課一次，要不然我就白跑一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ jīntiān Huáng jiàoshòu de kè tíngkè yī cì, yàobùrán wǒ jiù bái pǎo yī tàng le.
examples.english: Good thing you told me that Professor Huang's class is canceled today; otherwise, I would have made a trip in vain.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān tāmen yīnwèi yìdiǎnr xiǎo wùhuì chǎo le yí jià, háohǎo xiànzài héhǎo le.
examples.english: A few days ago they had a quarrel because of a small misunderstanding—good thing they've become reconciled now.

examples.chinese: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cǎi huā de shíhou bèi cì le yīxià, bùguò hái hǎo bù tài tòng.
examples.english: When I was picking flowers, I got pricked once, but fortunately it didn't hurt too much.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qúnzi pòle ge dòng, háohǎo shìyǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn, bāng wǒ bǔle qǐlái.
examples.english: My skirt had a hole, but luckily my roommate had a needle and thread and helped me mend it.

examples.chinese: 你畢業後要出國留學或是留在國內工作，都是不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìyè hòu yào chūguó liúxué huòshì liú zài guónèi gōngzuò, dōu shì bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: After you graduate, whether you go abroad to study or stay in the country to work, both are good choices.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó kāifàng guónèi tóuzī hòu, xiǎng tóuzī rénmínbì de rén yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
examples.english: After China opened up domestic investment, more and more people want to invest in RMB.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品，很多國內外的買家都十分感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn, hěn duō guónèi wài de mǎijiā dōu shífēn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: Many buyers, both domestic and foreign, are very interested in that painter's works.

examples.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén lìyòng xīnnián qījiān dào guówài lǚxíng, guónèi guònián de qìfēn jiù yuèláiyuè dàn le.
examples.english: Many people take advantage of the New Year period to travel abroad, so the atmosphere of celebrating the New Year domestically is becoming weaker and weaker.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 你的能力夠好，做這個工作一定沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de nénglì gòu hǎo, zuò zhè ge gōngzuò yīdìng méi wèntí.
examples.english: Your ability is good enough; doing this job will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
examples.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 要是你想出國留學，一定得加強外語能力。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng chūguó liúxué, yídìng děi jiāqiáng wàiyǔ nénglì.
examples.english: If you want to study abroad, you definitely have to strengthen your foreign language ability.

examples.chinese: 我相信有專業能力就比較容易找到好工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn yǒu zhuānyè nénglì jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: I believe that if you have professional ability, it is relatively easy to find a good job.

examples.chinese:
東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。
我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin:
Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng.
Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english:
Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance.
My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese:
如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。
為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin:
Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn.
Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english:
If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test.
In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
examples.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

examples.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
examples.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

examples.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
examples.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

examples.chinese: 有能力的人就算不幸失業了，將來還是有許多機會等待著他。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nénglì de rén jiùsuàn bùxìng shīyè le, jiānglái háishì yǒu xǔduō jīhuì děngdàizhe tā.
examples.english: Even if capable people unfortunately lose their jobs, there are still many opportunities waiting for them in the future.

examples.chinese: 對企業來說，一個人的工作能力往往比學歷更加重要。
examples.pinyin: Duì qǐyè lái shuō, yī ge rén de gōngzuò nénglì wǎngwǎng bǐ xuélì gèngjiā zhòngyào.
examples.english: For enterprises, a person's work ability is often more important than their educational background.

examples.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
examples.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, néng yīmiàn zhǎngwò huìyì de zhòngdiǎn, yīmiàn bǎ huìyì nèiróng fānyì chéng wàiwén.
examples.english: Miss Kang's work ability is very strong; she can simultaneously grasp the key points of a meeting and translate the meeting content into a foreign language.

examples.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
examples.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

examples.chinese: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
examples.pinyin: Bādé zài Huáyǔ nénglì cèyàn zhōng dé le bāshíliù fēn, hái ná dào le Huáyǔ gāojí zhèngshū, ràng tā kāixīn le bàntiān.
examples.english: Bade scored 86 on the Chinese proficiency test and also obtained an advanced Chinese certificate, which made her happy for a long time.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。

examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。

examples.english: I saw someone at the intersection holding up a sign, on which was an advertisement for selling houses.

examples.chinese: 大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。

examples.english: Most investment experts do not dare to guarantee that you can definitely make money in the housing market.

examples.chinese: 他決定搬到國外去，所以打算出售臺灣的房屋。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng bān dào guówài qù, suǒyǐ dǎsuàn chūshòu Táiwān de fángwū.
examples.english: He has decided to move abroad, so he plans to sell his house in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 處理老房屋的問題，有時比重新建築一棟房子還要困難。
examples.pinyin: Chǔlǐ lǎo fángwū de wèntí, yǒushí bǐ chóngxīn jiànzhù yī dòng fángzi hái yào kùnnán.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。

examples.english:
In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds.
The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。

examples.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。

examples.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

examples.chinese: 這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàizi shì wǒ xiǎoxué de jìlù, wǒ qǐng péngyǒu bǎ tā cún jìn diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: These tapes are records from my elementary school days; I asked a friend to save them onto the computer.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。

items.wordHook: To 記(record) a 錄(record): 記錄 means record, to record.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese:
我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。

許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。

Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient.
There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.

There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān, bù zhīdào zěnme zài yínháng kāihù cúnqián, qǐng jiào wǒ zěnme shēnqǐng.

examples.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。

examples.english: This restaurant's bill already includes a service charge; you don't need to give a tip.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。

examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo gēn lǎobǎn tǎolùn gōngzī wèntí, rènwéi gōngsī gěi de gōngqián réngrán tài dī.

items.wordHook: 下(down) + 雨(rain): rain coming down means "to rain".
A 二(two) arms stretch wide on a 人(person) — a grown 夫(man).
A 扌(hand) pushes you down into the 坐(seat) to 挫(check) your escape.
a 木(tree) trimmed to a 一(one) stub shows the 末(end).
Spreading 氵(water) expanding across a 曼(long) expanse becomes 漫(inundating).
Engaged in 產(give birth) study during student 生(life): 產生 means produce, to engender.
A refined creative work displaying 藝(art) and technical 術(skill) crafted as a fine 品(article): 藝術品 means work of art.
號(mark) + 碼(code) → a number is a mark/code, like a phone number. 號碼 means 'number'.
Combining 雲(cloud) and 端(end): 雲端 means cloud technology.
